AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Rift Needler Core
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Main weapon core for medium modular turret chassis. Fast needle bursts against lightly armored targets.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Primary gun module. Gives the chassis a fast 3-shot rift-needle burst for light enemies and swarm pressure.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Plasma Lance Core
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Main weapon core for medium modular turret chassis. Slower armor-focused ultra-plasma discharge.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Primary gun module. Replaces the main weapon with a slower long-range ultra-plasma bolt for armor and elite targets.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Ash Choir Repeater Core
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Main weapon core for medium modular turret chassis. Rapid ash-canticle repeater bursts for swarm suppression.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Primary gun module. Fires a fast 5-shot ash-canticle shard burst for light enemies, animals, and dense abyssal waves. Poor armor penetration keeps it dependent on lance or rail modules against elites.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Choir Arc Emitter
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Auxiliary support module. Fires a slow timed canticle-wave shot independently of the main weapon.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Auxiliary module. Adds an independent timed canticle-wave support shot while the main weapon keeps firing normally.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Cooling Lattice
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Passive cadence module. Reduces main weapon cooldown at the cost of additional power draw.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Passive module. Speeds up the main weapon cycle by reducing cooldown, but increases power draw.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Targeting Sigil
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Passive targeting module. Extends range and stabilizes the aiming geometry.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Passive module. Extends main weapon range and improves targeting geometry, but increases power draw.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Residue Capacitor
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Passive buffering module. Gives modest range and cadence gains while adding a larger power burden.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Passive module. Modestly improves range and main weapon cadence as a balanced late basic upgrade, with a larger power burden.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Sepulcher Rail Core
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Main weapon core for medium modular turret chassis. A late-tier dual-rail gauss accelerator that charges before firing a single anti-elite penetrator.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Primary gun module. Charges its twin rail planks, then fires a single high-velocity rail penetrator for long-range anti-armor and anti-elite defense. Passive cooldown modules also shorten the charge window.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Cinder Mortar Core
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Main weapon core for medium modular turret chassis. Lobs cinder-packed shells over cover to break clustered enemies and leave a short-lived burning residue field.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Primary gun module. Fires an indirect cinder mortar shell with a minimum range, compact explosive splash, and a brief hot-ash residue patch for area denial. Excellent against clustered enemies and static firing lines; poor against enemies already inside the deadzone.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Null-Arc Discharger
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Main weapon core for medium modular turret chassis. Charges a sanctified null capacitor, then releases a thin EMP arc that disrupts mechs, shielded targets, and nearby electronics through chained secondary strikes.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Primary gun module. Fires a charged null-arc pulse that deals moderate direct damage, applies strong EMP pressure, and chains to up to three nearby hostile pawns. Excellent against mechs, shield belts, and clustered elite support; inefficient as raw DPS against unshielded flesh.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Abyssal Harpoon Projector
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Main weapon core for medium modular turret chassis. Fires an anchor-spike bolt that impales dangerous melee threats, pins them under abyssal restraint, and briefly drags non-boss targets toward the chassis.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Primary gun module. Fires a heavy abyssal harpoon bolt for anti-breach lockdown. On hit it deals piercing damage, applies a slowing tether that reduces movement and melee dodge, and can micro-yank non-boss targets one or two cells toward the turret. Bosses and huge pawns receive a reduced tether but cannot be pulled.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Vesper Lance Array
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Main weapon core for medium modular turret chassis. Briefly charges, then fires a focused sanction lance for armor and elite targets.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Primary gun module. A saint-clean precision lance that sits between Plasma Lance and Sepulcher Rail: better reach and armor pressure than the former, far faster cadence than the latter.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Rift Flak Bloom
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Main weapon core for medium modular turret chassis. Fires an unstable rift canister that blooms near the target into cutting obsidian fragments for direct anti-cluster suppression.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Primary gun module. Launches a compact rift seed that detonates into a short radial shard bloom, striking several nearby hostile pawns with small cutting fragments. Strong against light swarms and clustered raiders; weak as raw anti-armor or boss DPS.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Sanctified Prism Emitter
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Main weapon core for medium modular turret chassis. Charges a cold prism guillotine, then fires a precise sanctified bolt that refracts through hostile pawns aligned behind the primary target.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Primary gun module. Fires a charged prism bolt for lane-control: the main hit deals moderate armor-pressure damage, then short refraction cuts continue through up to four hostile pawns in a narrow line behind the target. Strong in chokepoints and firing lanes; inefficient against scattered enemies, shields, and heavy boss targets.
